subject: Culture
title: Warrior Mothers
description: Learn Warrior Mothers in one minute.

hook.text: Spartan mothers told sons: 'Come back with your shield or on it.' Retreat was worse than death.

buildup.text: In many honor cultures women enforce the code as fiercely as men. Mothers shame sons who show cowardice.

discovery.text: Rajput women in India practiced 'jauhar'—mass self-immolation rather than surrender to enemy forces.

twist.text: Women weren't passive victims of honor culture. They were often its strictest enforcers and harshest judges.

climax.text: Even today, mothers-in-law in honor cultures often police daughters-in-law more harshly than any man does.

punchline.text: Honor systems recruit everyone as enforcers.
